title: Process Dependabot rust-toolchain update from current main
rawUserRequest: 继续处理当前仓库未完成的开放 Dependabot PR；对 PR #907 建立以当前 main 为基线的 successor Work Item，并完成验证、交付和生命周期关闭。

declaredIntent.summary: 将 Dependabot PR #907 的 rust-toolchain action pin 以当前 main 为真实基线重新交付，并保留原始 PR 作为来源事实。

outOfScope: requirements-dev.in, requirements-dev.txt, and requirements-dev.lock; those paths belong to separate mypy/ruff successor Work Items.
Changing compatibility matrix jobs, required checks, timeouts, or failure policy beyond the single Dependabot action pin.
Modifying the archived evidence of PR #907 or automatically merging the raw Dependabot PR.
Release publication, unrelated dependency updates, and unrelated Issue remediation.

sources.reason: Source Dependabot PR and requested rust-toolchain SHA transition.
Only implementation surface; the current action pin and compatibility matrix are defined here.
Repository policy requiring a current-main successor instead of direct raw Dependabot merge.
Canonical terms and lifecycle boundaries for governed Work Item delivery.
Start Receipt binding this successor to the exact current-main base.

riskAssessment.reason: The change is a single immutable action pin, but it affects the compatibility verification toolchain and must be proven on the current main baseline.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: PR #907, the target workflow, and the repository Dependabot successor policy define the bounded change and its verification boundary.

reasons: The Work Item changes a pinned CI action and requires hosted compatibility verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user instructed continuation after the open Dependabot PR was identified; this successor is bounded to PR #907 and current-main verification.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm the diff changes only the rust-toolchain action SHA and does not alter compatibility jobs or required gates.
Confirm hosted evidence is bound to the successor head and current-main base, not the stale raw Dependabot merge ref.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The current-main successor records PR #907 as its source and changes only the rust-toolchain action pin in .github/workflows/compatibility.yml.
The compatibility workflow remains pinned to the exact Dependabot target SHA and preserves all existing matrix jobs and required gates.
Local AI governance and quality checks pass without weakening tests, coverage, or hosted gates.
Fresh Hosted compatibility, smoke, installer, lifecycle, release-evidence, and CI-evidence checks pass for the successor PR.
Before closing this Work Item, ai-close-work-item passes and its closure receipt records the merged successor PR and absent local and remote successor branches.
guidelines: Keep the action pinned to an immutable commit SHA.
Do not weaken, skip, or retime existing compatibility and required CI gates.
Preserve the raw Dependabot PR as source evidence and deliver from current main.

intent.problem: PR #907 is a raw Dependabot candidate based on an obsolete main commit. Its Hosted checks ran against a stale merge ref and the repository's intake policy intentionally blocks raw Dependabot candidates until a current-main successor Work Item exists.
constraints: Use the recorded current main commit dc07070d85c8849afc72f473e89b151842da5bb1 as the base.
Change only .github/workflows/compatibility.yml for this dependency update.
Do not modify archived predecessor evidence or bypass the Dependabot intake policy.
Require fresh hosted evidence before merge and lifecycle closure.
intent.rationale: A fresh bounded successor separates immutable Dependabot source facts from the current repository baseline and prevents stale generated evidence from being mistaken for current verification.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The successor changes the compatibility workflow action pin from the old rust-toolchain SHA to PR #907's target SHA.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The diff contains exactly the intended immutable SHA update and no unrelated workflow change.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the branch diff and run the workflow/configuration checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The current-main successor runs the complete compatibility and repository smoke gates.
scenarioCoverage.expected: All required Hosted checks pass and evidence is bound to the successor head SHA.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run local ai-finish and require fresh Hosted PR checks before merge.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The raw Dependabot PR remains an obsolete source candidate while the successor is delivered.
scenarioCoverage.expected: No raw Dependabot PR is merged automatically; its source facts are referenced by the successor evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review PR state, source binding, and post-merge reconciliation.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user instructed continuation after the outstanding Dependabot PR was identified; this approval is limited to the declared single workflow pin change.

rollbackNote: Revert the successor PR or restore the previous rust-toolchain immutable SHA in .github/workflows/compatibility.yml; do not alter the raw Dependabot PR archive facts.
